key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: Seconds between sensor readings.

key.name: show-cpu-usage
key.description: Show the CPU usage percentage in the panel.

key.name: show-cpu-temp
key.description: Show the CPU package temperature in the panel.

key.name: show-cpu-power
key.description: Show the CPU package power draw in the panel. Needs read access to the powercap energy counter, or a chip reporting watts directly.

key.name: show-memory-usage
key.description: Show the used memory percentage in the panel.

key.name: show-disk-usage
key.description: Show the used space percentage of the monitored mount point in the panel.

key.name: show-disk-temp
key.description: Show the temperature of the hottest drive in the panel.

key.name: show-disk-io
key.description: Show the combined read and write throughput in the panel.

key.name: disk-mount
key.description: Filesystem whose used space is reported, for example / or /home.

key.name: show-gpu-usage
key.description: Show the GPU usage percentage in the panel, when the driver reports it.

key.name: show-gpu-vram
key.description: Show the used video memory in the panel, when the driver reports it.

key.name: gpu-vram-unit
key.description: Show the used video memory in the panel in GiB or as a percentage of the total.

key.name: show-gpu-temp
key.description: Show the GPU temperature in the panel.

key.name: show-gpu-power
key.description: Show the GPU power draw in the panel.

key.name: prefix-style
key.description: What identifies each group of panel values: the device icon, a text prefix such as CPU or RAM, or nothing.

key.name: color-cpu-usage
key.description: Color the CPU usage, in the panel and the menu, once it reaches its warning or critical threshold.

key.name: cpu-usage-warn
key.description: The CPU usage, in percent, shown as a warning.

key.name: cpu-usage-crit
key.description: The CPU usage, in percent, shown as critical.

key.name: color-cpu-temp
key.description: Color the CPU temperature, in the panel and the menu, once it reaches its warning or critical threshold.

key.name: cpu-temp-warn
key.description: The CPU temperature, in degrees Celsius, shown as a warning.

key.name: cpu-temp-crit
key.description: The CPU temperature, in degrees Celsius, shown as critical.

key.name: color-memory-usage
key.description: Color the memory usage, in the panel and the menu, once it reaches its warning or critical threshold.

key.name: memory-usage-warn
key.description: The memory usage, in percent, shown as a warning.

key.name: memory-usage-crit
key.description: The memory usage, in percent, shown as critical.

key.name: color-gpu-usage
key.description: Color the GPU usage, in the panel and the menu, once it reaches its warning or critical threshold.

key.name: gpu-usage-warn
key.description: The GPU usage, in percent, shown as a warning.

key.name: gpu-usage-crit
key.description: The GPU usage, in percent, shown as critical.

key.name: color-gpu-vram
key.description: Color the GPU memory, in the panel and the menu, once it reaches its warning or critical threshold.

key.name: gpu-vram-warn
key.description: The GPU memory, in percent of the total, shown as a warning.

key.name: gpu-vram-crit
key.description: The GPU memory, in percent of the total, shown as critical.

key.name: color-gpu-temp
key.description: Color the GPU temperature, in the panel and the menu, once it reaches its warning or critical threshold.

key.name: gpu-temp-warn
key.description: The GPU temperature, in degrees Celsius, shown as a warning.

key.name: gpu-temp-crit
key.description: The GPU temperature, in degrees Celsius, shown as critical.

key.name: color-disk-usage
key.description: Color the disk usage, in the panel and the menu, once it reaches its warning or critical threshold.

key.name: disk-usage-warn
key.description: The disk usage, in percent, shown as a warning.

key.name: disk-usage-crit
key.description: The disk usage, in percent, shown as critical.

key.name: color-disk-temp
key.description: Color the drive temperature, in the panel and the menu, once it reaches its warning or critical threshold.

key.name: disk-temp-warn
key.description: The drive temperature, in degrees Celsius, shown as a warning.

key.name: disk-temp-crit
key.description: The drive temperature, in degrees Celsius, shown as critical.

key.name: panel-box
key.description: Area of the top bar that holds the indicator: left, center or right.

key.name: panel-position
key.description: Order of the indicator within its area. Lower numbers go further left, so indicators with different numbers keep their order whichever loads first.
